title: Reported Speech · B2
framework: CEFR-informed HODIE learning content; not official certification.
note: These activities are authored and versioned in advance but must not be shown or counted as active B2 content until the evidence-based progression gate unlocks B2.

activities.title: Reported Speech: reporting nuance
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: matiza lo que se comunica
activities.prompt: Which report presents the claim as the speaker's, not a confirmed fact?
activities.promptEs: ¿Qué versión presenta la afirmación como algo dicho por la persona, no como un hecho confirmado?
options: She claimed that the figures were inaccurate.
The figures were inaccurate.
She said the figures were inaccurate, so it is certainly true.
activities.answer: She claimed that the figures were inaccurate.

feedback.correct: Claimed attributes the statement to the speaker without treating it as independently verified.
feedback.correctEs: Claimed atribuye la afirmación a quien habla sin presentarla como verificada de forma independiente.
feedback.incorrect: Choose the option that attributes the claim rather than endorsing it.
feedback.incorrectEs: Elige la opción que atribuye la afirmación sin respaldarla como hecho.

activities.title: Reported Speech: distinguish stance
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: distingue la postura
activities.prompt: Match the reporting verb to its communicative function.
activities.promptEs: Relaciona el verbo de reporte con su función comunicativa.
options: admitted → accepted something difficult or potentially negative
denied → said something was true
suggested → issued a direct order
activities.answer: admitted → accepted something difficult or potentially negative

feedback.correct: Reporting verbs convey stance; choose them according to the source and context.
feedback.correctEs: Los verbos de reporte transmiten postura; elígelos según la fuente y el contexto.
feedback.incorrect: Check the meaning and pragmatic force of each reporting verb.
feedback.incorrectEs: Revisa el significado y la fuerza pragmática de cada verbo de reporte.

activities.title: Reported Speech: summarise a discussion
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: resume una discusión
activities.prompt: Arrange a balanced summary of a discussion.
activities.promptEs: Organiza un resumen equilibrado de una discusión.
options: The team concluded that more evidence was needed.
One participant argued that the plan was too expensive.
Another participant suggested testing a smaller version first.
tokens: The team concluded that more evidence was needed.
One participant argued that the plan was too expensive.
Another participant suggested testing a smaller version first.
answer: One participant argued that the plan was too expensive.
Another participant suggested testing a smaller version first.
The team concluded that more evidence was needed.

feedback.correct: A balanced report distinguishes a concern, a proposal and the group's conclusion.
feedback.correctEs: Un reporte equilibrado distingue una preocupación, una propuesta y la conclusión del grupo.
feedback.incorrect: Present the concern, then the proposal, and finally the conclusion.
feedback.incorrectEs: Presenta la preocupación, luego la propuesta y finalmente la conclusión.

activities.title: Reported Speech: attribute a viewpoint
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: atribuye un punto de vista
activities.prompt: “This policy may fail,” the analyst said. → The analyst warned that the policy ___ fail.
activities.promptEs: «Esta política puede fracasar», dijo el analista. → The analyst warned that the policy ___ fail.
activities.answer: might

feedback.correct: Might can report a possibility with appropriate distance or tentativeness.
feedback.correctEs: Might puede transmitir una posibilidad con cierto distanciamiento o cautela.
feedback.incorrect: Use might to report the original possibility in this pattern.
feedback.incorrectEs: Usa might para transmitir la posibilidad original en este patrón.

activities.title: Reported Speech: preserve epistemic caution
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: conserva la cautela epistémica
activities.prompt: A researcher says, “The pattern may indicate a fault.” Which report preserves the degree of certainty?
activities.promptEs: Un investigador dice: «El patrón podría indicar una falla». ¿Qué reporte conserva el mismo grado de certeza?
options: The researcher said the pattern might indicate a fault.
The researcher confirmed that the pattern proved a fault.
The researcher denied that the pattern could indicate a fault.
activities.answer: The researcher said the pattern might indicate a fault.

feedback.correct: Might preserves the tentative possibility expressed by may. Confirmed and proved would overstate the evidence.
feedback.correctEs: Might conserva la posibilidad tentativa expresada por may. Confirmed y proved exagerarían la evidencia.
feedback.incorrect: Choose the version that keeps the claim tentative. Do not turn a possibility into a confirmed result.
feedback.incorrectEs: Elige la versión que mantiene la afirmación como tentativa. No conviertas una posibilidad en un resultado confirmado.

activities.title: Reported Speech: report a concession
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: comunica una concesión
activities.prompt: “The interface is clearer, although the workflow is still slow,” the reviewer said. Choose the balanced report.
activities.promptEs: Una persona revisora dice: «La interfaz es más clara, aunque el flujo de trabajo sigue siendo lento». Elige el reporte equilibrado.
options: The reviewer conceded that the interface was clearer but noted that the workflow remained slow.
The reviewer proved that the workflow was fast.
The reviewer denied that the interface was clearer.
activities.answer: The reviewer conceded that the interface was clearer but noted that the workflow remained slow.

feedback.correct: The report keeps both parts: the interface is clearer, but the workflow remains slow.
feedback.correctEs: El reporte conserva ambas partes: la interfaz es más clara, pero el flujo de trabajo sigue siendo lento.
feedback.incorrect: Do not remove either side of the concession. The report must keep the improvement and the limitation.
feedback.incorrectEs: No elimines ninguna parte de la concesión. El reporte debe conservar la mejora y la limitación.

activities.title: Reported Speech: choose the precise reporting verb
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: elige el verbo de reporte preciso
activities.prompt: A witness accepts that they made a mistake. Which verb best captures this act?
activities.promptEs: Un testigo acepta que cometió un error. ¿Qué verbo comunica mejor ese acto?
options: admitted
denied
predicted
activities.answer: admitted

feedback.correct: Admitted means accepting or acknowledging something, often something negative. Denied rejects it; predicted refers to a future possibility.
feedback.correctEs: Admitted significa aceptar o reconocer algo, a menudo algo negativo. Denied lo rechaza; predicted se refiere a una posibilidad futura.
feedback.incorrect: Choose the verb that acknowledges the mistake, not one that rejects it or predicts a future event.
feedback.incorrectEs: Elige el verbo que reconoce el error, no uno que lo rechaza o predice un hecho futuro.

activities.title: Reported Speech: avoid changing attribution into fact
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: distingue atribución y hecho
activities.prompt: A memo says, “The contractor claimed that the sensor had failed before delivery.” Which summary is appropriately cautious?
activities.promptEs: Un memorando dice: «El contratista afirmó que el sensor había fallado antes de la entrega». ¿Qué resumen mantiene la cautela adecuada?
options: The memo reports the contractor's claim that the sensor had failed before delivery.
The sensor definitely failed before delivery.
The memo establishes that the contractor was responsible.
activities.answer: The memo reports the contractor's claim that the sensor had failed before delivery.

feedback.correct: The summary attributes the allegation to the contractor. It does not independently establish that the sensor failed.
feedback.correctEs: El resumen atribuye la afirmación al contratista. No demuestra de forma independiente que el sensor fallara.
feedback.incorrect: Keep the source attached to the claim. Do not present the contractor's statement as verified fact.
feedback.incorrectEs: Mantén la fuente vinculada a la afirmación. No presentes la declaración del contratista como un hecho verificado.

activities.title: Reported Speech: interpret hedging
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: interpreta una formulación cautelosa
activities.prompt: “The results appear to support the proposal, though the sample is small.” What is the most accurate interpretation?
activities.promptEs: «Los resultados parecen respaldar la propuesta, aunque la muestra es pequeña». ¿Cuál es la interpretación más precisa?
options: The evidence seems supportive, but the writer signals a limitation.
The results conclusively prove the proposal.
The writer rejects the proposal completely.
activities.answer: The evidence seems supportive, but the writer signals a limitation.

feedback.correct: Appears signals a cautious interpretation, while the small sample is an explicit limitation.
feedback.correctEs: Appears señala una interpretación cautelosa, mientras que la muestra pequeña es una limitación explícita.
feedback.incorrect: Keep both the tentative support and the limitation. The sentence does not claim conclusive proof.
feedback.incorrectEs: Conserva tanto el apoyo tentativo como la limitación. La oración no afirma que exista una prueba concluyente.

activities.title: Reported Speech: detect a shift in stance
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: detecta un cambio de postura
activities.prompt: Source: “The team suggested a pilot; it did not recommend a full launch.” Which summary changes the source's stance?
activities.promptEs: Fuente: «El equipo sugirió una prueba piloto; no recomendó un lanzamiento completo». ¿Qué resumen cambia la postura de la fuente?
options: The team recommended launching the product to everyone immediately.
The team suggested testing a pilot first.
The team did not recommend a full launch.
activities.answer: The team recommended launching the product to everyone immediately.

feedback.correct: This summary turns a limited pilot suggestion into an immediate full launch, which the source explicitly did not recommend.
feedback.correctEs: Este resumen convierte la sugerencia de una prueba piloto limitada en un lanzamiento completo inmediato, algo que la fuente no recomendó.
feedback.incorrect: Look for the option that turns the pilot into a full launch. The source distinguishes a test from a general release.
feedback.incorrectEs: Busca la opción que convierte el piloto en un lanzamiento completo. La fuente distingue una prueba de una publicación general.

activities.title: Reported Speech: distinguish admission from proof
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: distingue admisión y prueba
activities.prompt: “The supplier admitted that the shipment had arrived late.” What does this sentence establish?
activities.promptEs: «El proveedor admitió que el envío había llegado tarde». ¿Qué establece esta oración?
options: The supplier acknowledged the late arrival; it does not explain the cause by itself.
The supplier proved that the customer caused the delay.
The shipment arrived early.
activities.answer: The supplier acknowledged the late arrival; it does not explain the cause by itself.

feedback.correct: Admitted reports that the supplier acknowledged the late arrival. It does not identify the cause of the delay.
feedback.correctEs: Admitted comunica que el proveedor reconoció la llegada tardía. No identifica la causa del retraso.
feedback.incorrect: Do not infer who caused the delay. The sentence reports an admission about timing only.
feedback.incorrectEs: No infieras quién causó el retraso. La oración comunica una admisión sobre el momento de llegada.

activities.title: Reported Speech: listen for qualification
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: escucha los matices
activities.prompt: Listen and choose the summary that keeps the speaker's qualification.
activities.promptEs: Escucha y elige el resumen que conserva la cautela de la persona analista.
options: The analyst said the figures appeared encouraging but advised waiting for a larger sample before concluding.
The analyst said the figures proved the project was successful.
The analyst said no further evidence was needed.
activities.answer: The analyst said the figures appeared encouraging but advised waiting for a larger sample before concluding.

feedback.correct: The report preserves both the encouraging initial figures and the advice to wait for a larger sample before concluding.
feedback.correctEs: El reporte conserva tanto las cifras iniciales alentadoras como el consejo de esperar una muestra mayor antes de concluir.
feedback.incorrect: Listen for the positive assessment and the explicit limit: the sample must be larger before drawing a conclusion.
feedback.incorrectEs: Escucha la valoración positiva y el límite explícito: la muestra debe ser mayor antes de sacar una conclusión.

activities.audioText: The analyst said, 'The new figures appear encouraging, but we should wait for a larger sample before drawing a conclusion.'

activities.title: Reported Speech: track competing viewpoints
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: escucha dos posturas distintas
activities.prompt: Listen and choose the balanced report.
activities.promptEs: Escucha y elige el reporte equilibrado de las dos personas.
options: Marta expected time savings, while Joel supported the layout but warned about retraining time.
Both speakers agreed that no training was needed.
Joel rejected the redesign because the layout was unclear.
activities.answer: Marta expected time savings, while Joel supported the layout but warned about retraining time.

feedback.correct: The report keeps Marta's expected time savings and Joel's support for the layout alongside his warning about staff retraining.
feedback.correctEs: El reporte conserva el ahorro de tiempo que espera Marta y el apoyo de Joel al diseño, junto con su advertencia sobre la capacitación del personal.
feedback.incorrect: Do not make the speakers agree completely. Marta highlights time savings; Joel adds a training concern.
feedback.incorrectEs: No hagas que las dos personas estén totalmente de acuerdo. Marta destaca el ahorro de tiempo; Joel añade una preocupación sobre la capacitación.

activities.audioText: Marta argued that the redesign would save time. Joel agreed about the clearer layout but warned that retraining staff would take several weeks.

activities.title: Reported Speech: identify an unsupported inference
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: identifica una inferencia no sustentada
activities.prompt: Listen to the statement and choose only what it supports.
activities.promptEs: Escucha la declaración y elige únicamente lo que permite afirmar.
options: The manager reported fewer errors in two teams but said long-term results were not yet checked.
The update has permanently eliminated errors across the company.
The manager said the update had no effect.
activities.answer: The manager reported fewer errors in two teams but said long-term results were not yet checked.

feedback.correct: The manager reports fewer errors in two teams but explicitly says long-term results have not been checked.
feedback.correctEs: La gerente comunica menos errores en dos equipos, pero indica explícitamente que aún no se han comprobado los resultados a largo plazo.
feedback.incorrect: Do not infer a permanent or company-wide effect. The speaker limits the claim to two teams and notes that long-term results remain unchecked.
feedback.incorrectEs: No infieras un efecto permanente ni para toda la empresa. La persona limita la afirmación a dos equipos y señala que faltan comprobaciones a largo plazo.

activities.audioText: The manager said, 'Two teams reported fewer errors after the update, although we have not yet checked the long-term results.'

activities.title: Reported Speech: say a cautious conclusion
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: expresa una conclusión cautelosa
activities.prompt: Say the model sentence, preserving the cautious meaning.
activities.promptEs: Di la oración modelo y conserva el significado prudente.
activities.answer: The reviewer suggested that the results might be promising.

feedback.correct: The model preserves the tentative word might. Transcript matching checks key words, not full pronunciation or every grammar choice.
feedback.correctEs: El modelo conserva la palabra tentativa might. La coincidencia de transcripción comprueba palabras clave, no toda la pronunciación ni cada decisión gramatical.
feedback.incorrect: Keep might to avoid overstating the evidence. The automatic check only looks for required words.
feedback.incorrectEs: Conserva might para no exagerar la evidencia. La comprobación automática solo busca las palabras requeridas.

activities.targetPhrase: The reviewer suggested that the results might be promising.

activities.title: Reported Speech: report a concession
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: comunica una concesión
activities.prompt: Say the model sentence with both sides of the viewpoint.
activities.promptEs: Di la oración modelo e incluye ambos lados del punto de vista.
activities.answer: She acknowledged that the design was simpler but warned that it was less flexible.

feedback.correct: The sentence reports the simpler design and the warning that it is less flexible.
feedback.correctEs: La oración comunica que el diseño es más sencillo y la advertencia de que es menos flexible.
feedback.incorrect: Include both the acknowledgement and the warning; omitting either changes the speaker's position.
feedback.incorrectEs: Incluye tanto el reconocimiento como la advertencia; omitir uno cambia la postura de quien habla.

activities.targetPhrase: She acknowledged that the design was simpler but warned that it was less flexible.

activities.title: Reported Speech: write a balanced evidence summary
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: redacta un resumen equilibrado de evidencia
activities.prompt: Write a 2–3 sentence summary: a small trial produced encouraging results, but the sample was too small to confirm the effect.
activities.promptEs: Escribe de dos a tres oraciones: una prueba pequeña produjo resultados alentadores, pero la muestra era demasiado reducida para confirmar el efecto.

feedback.correct: A strong summary attributes the finding, mentions the small sample and avoids claiming that the effect has been proven.
feedback.correctEs: Un buen resumen atribuye el resultado, menciona la muestra pequeña y evita afirmar que el efecto esté demostrado.
feedback.incorrect: Include the encouraging result and the sample-size limitation. Do not turn preliminary evidence into proof.
feedback.incorrectEs: Incluye el resultado alentador y la limitación del tamaño de la muestra. No conviertas evidencia preliminar en una prueba.

criteria.label: Attribute the report to its source
criteria.missingMessage: Attribute the claim or viewpoint to its source.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Atribuye la afirmación o punto de vista a su fuente.

criteria.label: Preserve uncertainty or qualification
criteria.missingMessage: Preserve the original qualification or uncertainty.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Conserva el matiz o la incertidumbre original.

activities.title: Reported Speech: attribute a disputed claim
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: atribuye una afirmación controvertida
activities.prompt: Write a short neutral summary of a disputed claim. Attribute the claim to its source and state that it has not been independently verified.
activities.promptEs: Escribe un resumen neutral de una afirmación discutida. Atribúyela a su fuente e indica que no ha sido verificada de forma independiente.

feedback.correct: The response should identify the source and make the verification boundary explicit.
feedback.correctEs: La respuesta debe identificar la fuente y dejar explícito el límite de verificación.
feedback.incorrect: Name who made the claim and state that it has not been independently verified; do not present it as settled fact.
feedback.incorrectEs: Indica quién hizo la afirmación y señala que no se ha verificado de forma independiente; no la presentes como un hecho establecido.

criteria.label: Attribute the report to its source
criteria.missingMessage: Attribute the claim or viewpoint to its source.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Atribuye la afirmación o punto de vista a su fuente.

criteria.label: Preserve uncertainty or qualification
criteria.missingMessage: Preserve the original qualification or uncertainty.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Conserva el matiz o la incertidumbre original.

activities.title: Reported Speech: repair an overconfident summary
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: corrige un resumen demasiado seguro
activities.prompt: Source: “The initial feedback suggests that the change may help.” Which report avoids overstating the source?
activities.promptEs: Fuente: «Los comentarios iniciales sugieren que el cambio podría ayudar». ¿Qué reporte evita exagerar la afirmación original?
options: The initial feedback suggests the change may help.
The change has been proven to solve the problem.
The feedback confirms that the change always works.
activities.answer: The initial feedback suggests the change may help.

feedback.correct: The report keeps both the limited source (“initial feedback”) and the tentative modal “may”.
feedback.correctEs: El reporte conserva tanto la fuente limitada («comentarios iniciales») como el modal tentativo «may».
feedback.incorrect: Avoid claims such as proven or always works. The source only suggests a possible benefit.
feedback.incorrectEs: Evita afirmaciones como proven o always works. La fuente solo sugiere un posible beneficio.

activities.title: Reported Speech: preserve disagreement
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: conserva el desacuerdo
activities.prompt: A says the schedule is realistic. B says it is too ambitious. Which report preserves the disagreement?
activities.promptEs: Una persona considera realista el horario y otra cree que es demasiado ambicioso. ¿Qué reporte conserva el desacuerdo?
options: A considered the schedule realistic, whereas B felt it was too ambitious.
Everyone agreed that the schedule was realistic.
A and B both rejected the schedule.
activities.answer: A considered the schedule realistic, whereas B felt it was too ambitious.

feedback.correct: Whereas clearly contrasts the two positions without pretending the speakers agree.
feedback.correctEs: Whereas contrasta claramente las dos posturas sin fingir que las personas están de acuerdo.
feedback.incorrect: Attribute each opinion to the correct speaker and keep the contrast between realistic and too ambitious.
feedback.incorrectEs: Atribuye cada opinión a la persona correcta y conserva el contraste entre realista y demasiado ambicioso.

activities.title: Reported Speech: distinguish proposal from instruction
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: distingue una propuesta de una instrucción
activities.prompt: “The engineer suggested restarting the device.” What did the engineer do?
activities.promptEs: «El ingeniero sugirió reiniciar el dispositivo». ¿Qué hizo el ingeniero?
options: Proposed a possible action.
Ordered the team to restart it.
Confirmed that it had already restarted.
activities.answer: Proposed a possible action.

feedback.correct: Suggested reports a proposal or possible action; it does not mean the engineer ordered the team to act.
feedback.correctEs: Suggested comunica una propuesta o acción posible; no significa que el ingeniero ordenara actuar al equipo.
feedback.incorrect: Choose the option that describes a proposal, not an order or a claim that the restart already happened.
feedback.incorrectEs: Elige la opción que describe una propuesta, no una orden ni una afirmación de que el reinicio ya ocurrió.

activities.title: Reported Speech: report an allegation carefully
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: comunica una acusación con cuidado
activities.prompt: A witness says, “I believe the figures were altered.” Which report preserves the witness's level of certainty?
activities.promptEs: Un testigo dice: «Creo que las cifras fueron alteradas». ¿Qué reporte conserva su grado de certeza?
options: The witness said they believed the figures had been altered.
The witness proved that the figures had been altered.
The witness confirmed that the figures were accurate.
activities.answer: The witness said they believed the figures had been altered.

feedback.correct: The report keeps the witness's belief as a belief; it does not turn it into a proven alteration.
feedback.correctEs: El reporte mantiene la creencia del testigo como una creencia; no la convierte en una alteración demostrada.
feedback.incorrect: Keep the attribution “they believed”. Do not replace a belief with confirmed proof.
feedback.incorrectEs: Conserva la atribución «creían». No sustituyas una creencia por una prueba confirmada.

activities.title: Reported Speech: summarise a nuanced argument
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: resume un argumento matizado
activities.prompt: Source: “Although the tool is faster, it may not be suitable for every classroom.” Which summary preserves both parts?
activities.promptEs: Fuente: «Aunque la herramienta es más rápida, puede que no sea adecuada para todas las aulas». ¿Qué resumen conserva ambas partes?
options: The source recognises the speed advantage but questions whether the tool fits every classroom.
The source says the tool is unsuitable for all classrooms.
The source says speed is irrelevant.
activities.answer: The source recognises the speed advantage but questions whether the tool fits every classroom.

feedback.correct: The summary keeps the speed advantage and the qualification about suitability across classrooms.
feedback.correctEs: El resumen conserva la ventaja de velocidad y el matiz sobre su idoneidad en distintas aulas.
feedback.incorrect: Do not remove the concession or turn may not into a categorical rejection.
feedback.incorrectEs: No elimines la concesión ni conviertas may not en un rechazo categórico.

activities.title: Reported Speech: compare two attributed claims
activities.titleEs: Estilo indirecto: compara dos afirmaciones atribuidas
activities.prompt: Write a concise comparison of two sources that disagree about a new policy. Attribute each position and avoid deciding which is true without evidence.
activities.promptEs: Escribe una comparación breve de dos fuentes que discrepan sobre una política nueva. Atribuye cada postura y no decidas cuál es verdadera sin evidencia.

feedback.correct: A strong comparison attributes both positions to their sources and distinguishes disagreement from verified fact.
feedback.correctEs: Una buena comparación atribuye ambas posturas a sus fuentes y distingue el desacuerdo de un hecho verificado.
feedback.incorrect: Identify each source, state the difference between their claims and avoid choosing a winner without evidence.
feedback.incorrectEs: Identifica cada fuente, indica la diferencia entre sus afirmaciones y evita elegir una como verdadera sin evidencia.

criteria.label: Attribute the report to its source
criteria.missingMessage: Attribute the claim or viewpoint to its source.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Atribuye la afirmación o punto de vista a su fuente.

criteria.label: Preserve uncertainty or qualification
criteria.missingMessage: Preserve the original qualification or uncertainty.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Conserva el matiz o la incertidumbre original.
